derivation: a primitive root; properly, to divide up; but used only as denominative from H5585 (סָעִיף),

occurrences.text: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
